channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Piracy rises off Somalia as US-Israeli war on Iran diverts naval forces
item.description: Somali pirates are holding over a dozen sailors, mostly from Pakistan, hostage as hijackings and harassment surge. The increase in piracy comes as naval forces are diverted due to the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: US Alerts on Chinese and Russian Space Threats in Global Security
item.description: The US has alerted on Chinese and Russian space threats to global security. The warning highlights potential dangers from the two nations' space capabilities. US Alerts on Chinese and Russian Space Threats in Global Security India News Network.

item.title: Iranians Live With Pain and Powerlessness, Beneath a Smooth Veneer
item.description: Iranians are coping with grief, economic stress, and loss of hope after months of upheaval. Many are attempting to get on with their lives despite the challenges. After months of upheaval, many are attempting to get on with their lives while quietly grappling with grief, economic stress and a loss of hope.

item.title: NMSU Model United Nations extends long−standing streak of top honors
item.description: New Mexico State University's Model United Nations team has extended its streak of top honors. The team achieved the feat through its consistent performance. NMSU Model United Nations extends long−standing streak of top honors TheNewsMarket.

item.title: More than 500 million tickets requested for World Cup, says FIFA boss
item.description: FIFA boss reported that over 500 million tickets have been requested for the World Cup. The event is expected to draw a massive audience. More than 500 million tickets requested for World Cup, says FIFA boss.

item.title: Iran will be at World Cup and will play in the US, says FIFA boss
item.description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino confirmed Iran's participation in the World Cup and mentioned that Iran will play in the US. The details of the matches and schedule were not provided.

item.title: Lebanese girl mourns paramedic father killed in Israeli strike
item.description: A young Lebanese girl mourned her father, a paramedic killed in an Israeli strike. Hundreds attended the funeral of the father and two other paramedics. A young girl in Lebanon joined hundreds mourning her father, one of three paramedics killed in an Israeli attack.

item.title: US-Israel-Iran Ceasefire Live Updates: Trump Floats New Plan Aimed At Creating Maritime Alliance To
item.description: US President Donald Trump proposed a new plan for a maritime alliance. The plan aims to ease tensions between the US, Israel, and Iran. US Israel Iran War Ceasefire News LIVE Updates:.

item.title: How Serbia's government dominates the country's media
item.description: Serbia's ruling SNS party has tightened its grip on the media since coming to power. Experts fear the government will suppress independent reporting ahead of an expected election. Since Serbia's ruling SNS party came to power, it has tightened its grip on the media.

item.title: What to Know About the Stabbing Attack Against 2 Jewish Men in London
item.description: British police treated a stabbing attack on two Jewish men in London as terrorism. The police also warned of rising antisemitic hate crimes. The British police said the attack on Wednesday was being treated as terrorism, and they warned of rising antisemitic hate crimes.

item.title: F1 newcomers Cadillac hoping to step up at first home race in Miami
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said a US naval blockade of Iran's ports is effectively an extension of military operations, despite an ongoing ceasefire between the two sides. The blockade has been in place since the US withdrew from the Iran nuclear deal in 2018.

item.title: Attacks on Jewish Targets in Europe Suggest Hybrid Warfare
item.description: A shadowy Islamist group claimed attacks on Jewish targets in Europe. Officials are investigating similar attacks across Europe, all claimed by a shadowy Islamist group that may be using low-cost, unsophisticated methods to sow fear in Jewish communities.

item.title: Myanmar’s former leader Aung San Suu Kyi moved to house arrest
item.description: Myanmar's former leader Aung San Suu Kyi has been moved to house arrest as part of a prisoner pardon tied to a Buddhist religious holiday. The move comes after Suu Kyi's conviction on corruption charges in a highly publicized trial.

item.title: Israel Did Not Choose War. It Chose to Win It
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has stated that Israel chose to win the recent conflict, rather than choosing war. The statement comes after a ceasefire was brokered in the region.

item.title: The High Seas Treaty: Hope for Humanity
item.description: The United Nations has adopted the High Seas Treaty, a landmark agreement aimed at protecting the world's oceans. The treaty establishes a framework for the conservation and sustainable use of marine biodiversity.

item.title: US Blockade Of Ports An "Extension Of Military Operations": Iran President
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has accused the US of extending military operations through a naval blockade of Iran's ports. The blockade has been in place since the US withdrew from the Iran nuclear deal in 2018.

item.title: Oil price hits highest since 2022 after report Trump to be briefed on new Iran options
item.description: US Central Command has prepared a plan for strikes on Iran, Axios reported. The news caused oil prices to hit their highest level since 2022, as Trump is to be briefed on new Iran options.

item.title: UN chief calls for immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. He called for the strait to be reopened without delay. UN Secretary-General António Guterres has urged the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Hegseth says Iran war can continue despite legal deadline
item.description: Politico reported that Hegseth stated the Iran war can continue despite a legal deadline. No further details were provided on the legal deadline or the war. Hegseth says Iran war can continue despite legal deadline Politico.

item.title: Supreme Court hollows out a landmark law that had protected minority voting rights for 6 decades
item.description: The US Supreme Court ruled in a Louisiana congressional redistricting case. The decision impacted a law that had protected minority voting rights for six decades. The Supreme Court's ruling came in a congressional redistricting case out of Louisiana after the State created a district that gave the State its second Black representative to Congress.
